extraction.NOTES: Cover letter dated March 20, 1929, from Shawnee Indian Agency, Shawnee, Oklahoma, to Commissioner of Indian Affairs, Washington, D.C., submitted in response to Office instructions of June 18, 1928, Circular No. 2464.
